purpose: Requirements defining how the evaluator independently judges reviewer findings using meta-perspectives, creates new findings, and what it returns as evaluations, with no error values.
summary: Evaluator purpose: independently verify findings, reject wrong ones, and show the true cause
Scope: evaluator-specific behavior only; exchange, numbering, exit values and data structures are delegated to the common review contract
FNC-208: contents of the evaluator definition, reading starts from the finding rather than the whole target
FNC-201: five meta-perspectives questioning root cause, source information, existing decisions, reasonable reading, and own judgment
FNC-206: evaluator may newly report reviewer oversights, always with disposition valid and explicit location
FNC-209: evaluations are written after all judgments are fixed; zero findings can still yield new findings
FNC-319: evaluator has no error values; unreadable locations are judgment material
DM-202: input is the request plus findings read separately, with no merged input file
Open item TBD-001: effectiveness of the meta-perspectives to be verified after implementation
tasks: Writing or revising the evaluator agent definition
Implementing evaluation output through the delivery script
Reviewing evaluator behavior in the review workflow
Deciding handling of flawed_premise or new findings by the evaluator
title: REQ-026 evaluator の独立評価とメタ観点 要件定義書
